All Records are on micro-film starting from June 1, 1965.
Anyone wishing to look up recorded documents on-line may visit doxpop.com to use the service. A low-volume search plan is available for free, with higher-volume subscriptions available to commercial users for a fee
E-recording of select document types now available via CSC and Simplifile, EPN and Indecomm.
Notice of Upcoming Dates
November 24 , 2026 – Recorder’s Office will be closed 12pm-2pm for County Employee Thanksgiving Dinner
December 23 , 2026 – Recorder’s Office will close for the day at 2pm for County Employee Christmas Party. Recording cut off time is 12pm (Noon) Documents received after 12pm will be recorded on Monday December 28 th ,2026
December 31 , 2026 - Recording cut off time is 11am. Documents received after 11am will be recorded Monday January 4 th , 2027
Property Owner Alert
Some Wells County property owners have received an official looking solicitation from a company named LOCAL RECORDS OFFICE in Indianapolis. This company offers to sell you a copy of your deed for an extremely inflated price of $121.50. A copy of your deed can be found in the Recorders Office at $1.00 per page or on the online service doxpop.com .
Property Fraud Protection
The Wells County Recorders office is now working with Equity Protect to help give landowners information on protecting their property from fraud.
Learn more about protecting your property from fraud by clicking this link.
Military Discharge Request
To request Military DD-214’s please use the State of Indiana’s request site here .
Recorders Fee Schedule
Deeds – $25.00
Fee includes 1 oversize page
Mortgages – $55.00
Fee includes 1 oversize page
Affidavits/Other Documents – $25.00
Fee includes 1 oversize page
Release/Partial Release/Assignment – $25.00
Fee includes 1 oversize page.
Additional pages exceeding 8.5″ x 14″ within any document – $5.00
Mechanics Lien & Common Law Lien – $25.00
Including one mail out
Each additional mail out – $2.00
Photographic Copies of Recorder’s Records (per page) – $1.00
Not Exceeding 8.5″ x 14″
Certified Copies of Documents – $5.00
(plus $1.00 per page for copies)
Non-Conforming – All documents must have a two inch margin on the top and bottom of the first and last pages per IC 36-2-11-16-.5.
Affirmation Statement
A document may not be submitted to the County Recorder for recording or filing that contains a Social Security number unless required by law. IC36-2-7.5-4
Prepared By Statement
All documents, unless exempted by IC36-2-11-15(a) must identify the name of the preparer of the document and state the required affirmation verbatim in IC36-2-11-15(d)
Uniform Commercial Code
Beginning 7-1-2001 all financing statements involving personal property are to be filed at the Indiana Secretary of State’s office. Failure to file in the proper office may affect the perfection of the lien.
Financing Statement - $25.00
Amendment - $25.00
Search 1 Name - $25.00
(a copy of each page of a searched document is an additional $1.00 each)
All instruments must meet recording form and legibility statutes.
